title: This is the world’s first robot that can detect skin cancer automatically
description:
This is the world’s first robot that can detect skin cancer automatically.

What you’re looking at is called the Swan.

And I think this is the future of preventative wellness.

The Swan is a robotic arm equipped with high resolution sensors.

In just a few minutes, it can take thousands of detailed images of your skin and feeds them into an AI model.

But here’s the cool part…

The model can then stitch together all those images to create a super realistic digital twin of your skin.

And this allows for detailed skin tracking overtime.

When you go to a normal doctor, they can of course notice when things look off.

But unless they took pictures the first time, they don’t have a reference to track how things are changing.

Swan, and other robotic imaging, will change this completely.

Imagine a future where you get your skin scanned every12 months and your digital twin can instantly show things have changed.

New spots, changing spots, irregularities.

Immediately, healthcare becomes a trend line instead of a random point in time.

Whether it’s The Swan for skin or Daniel Ek’s startup Neko Health…this is definitely where the future of wellness is headed.

It’s crazy how little we all know about the current state of our bodies.

But I think, in a few years, complete body scans like this will be the new normal.
